About AnyCARE

AnyCARE is an innovative and nimble telehealth solutions provider. We provide the health care solutions to seniors, families with elderly parents, senior care service providers, health insurance and healthcare industries.

Our goal is to enhance the health and safety of seniors and reduce the overall medical costs by empowering seniors to take care of their health proactively and providing data-driven health management tools for senior care providers to improve their efficiency.

AnyCARE Remote Health Monitoring service platform enables 24/7 health monitoring and medical alerts services, which can be customized for various business partners in global locations,

AnyCARE key strength lies in its ability to rapidly develop and commercialize total end-to-end health and satefy solutions utilizing the latest wearables and IT technologies.

AnyCARE TAP2 Health Watch with Remote Health Monitoring & Medical Alert

AnyCARE TAP2 measures body temperature, heart rate, blood oxygen(SpO2), heart rate variability(HRV), activities and sleep quality. The watch displays the body temperature, heart rate and activities trends and update the data every 30 minutes. The watch is a valuable self-care tool with the real-time health data at hand.

AnyCARE Family Connect app enables the watch user's family & caregivers to monitor their loved one's vitals remotely as idenifying early health problems of loved one is so important.

AnyCARE Help Connect app provides an urgent messaging capability for the watch user to get help form their neighbors or friends nearby by double tapping the face of the watch in case they can't reach the phone for help due to a fall or medical conditions.

Unlimited number of family members, caregivers, firends and neighbors can use these apps for free with the watch user's subscription. One year watch user's subscription is included in the watch price.
